environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on an AWS EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The instance has an IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. The instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is enabled. No egress filtering is applied to the instance's security group (all outbound traffic allowed). The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the application on port 5000. No rate limiting is configured at any layer.
